title: Loafer
desc: Ranjeet is a thief who works for Mr Singh. When they plan to steal precious jewellery, their enemy, Pratap, coerces Anju to spy on Ranjeet in order to kill him.

title: Prem Granth
desc: Somen, a rich man, falls in love with Kajri, a village belle. However, they get separated when she suddenly leaves for unknown reasons.

title: Main Khiladi Tu Anari
desc: A Bombay police officer seeks revenge when a drug dealer kills his brother. However, things get complicated when a film star begins to tag along, so that he can research a film role.

title: Gopi Kishan
desc: Policeman Gopi's doppelgänger Kishan, who is a criminal, learns about the former and uses his identity to his advantage as he tries to find his father. This results in Gopi reaping the benefits.
